messages:
Priya: Quick design check — proposing a new interrupt flow for the Playground streaming chat.
Priya: When user hits Stop, we keep the partial reply visible, show a subtle shimmer to indicate the stream stopped, and surface a single primary "Regenerate" CTA plus a secondary "Resume" option for continuing the same generation.
Sam: I'm nervous about Stop vs Pause wording. People think Stop means discard.
Sam: Maybe "Pause"/"Resume" and "Regenerate" as a separate action? :thinking:
Miguel: Accessibility nits: if we show both Regenerate and Resume they need distinct aria-labels and focus order.
Miguel: Also keyboard-only users should be able to hit Enter to resume or r to regenerate — but only if we document the shortcut.
Jordan: On metrics: keeping partial responses will change how we count tokens in the UI summary. We need to ensure the token counter reflects generated tokens only, and shows partial length. Also affects billing display — flagging billing team.
Alex: Gif of prototype here: https://figma.com/proto/xyz (preview)
Alex: Visual note — the shimmer after Stop feels like a failure state. Maybe reduce to a small pulsing chevron instead.
Taylor: A/B idea: Variant A (current proposal) shows Regenerate prominent; Variant B collapses secondary Resume into an overflow menu and uses a single primary "Take action" dropdown. Track regen CTR and resume rate.
Priya: Good call. For copy I'm leaning "Stop stream" (button) then when stopped show "Regenerate" and "Continue stream" instead of Resume.
Miguel: If we go with "Continue stream", aria-label should be "Continue streaming the current response". For regeneration: "Generate a new response from the same prompt".
Priya: Here's a tiny ARIA snippet for the React button props:
Priya: ```jsx
<button aria-label="Continue streaming the current response" aria-live="polite">Continue</button>
<button aria-label="Generate a new response from the same prompt">Regenerate</button>
``` 
Sam: Suggest adding an announcement when stream stops: "Stream paused — partial result shown. Press Regenerate to try again."
Jordan: Ops note — streaming websocket still stays open if user chooses Continue; if they Regenerate we must clear KV-cache for that session ID. Make sure runtime team knows.
Alex: Design-bot: Figma updated with both variants -> https://figma.com/file/abc (attached)
design-bot: @channel Updated frames and accessibility annotations.
Taylor: Rollout plan: prod dark-launch with 1% traffic, metric watch: regen CTR, resume CTR, avg latency, token delta. If regen spikes, revert.
Priya: Ok next steps: Alex to tweak shimmer to pulsing chevron, Miguel to add aria copy + keyboard shortcuts doc, Jordan to confirm KV-cache flow with runtime, Taylor to set up A/B experiment, Sam to finalize microcopy. I'll sync with PM and draft rollout notes.
Sam: +1, will send copy options in the doc.
Miguel: I'll add the accessibility checklist to the thread.
Jordan: Noted — I'll ping infra about KV-cache.
Priya: Thanks all! :heart:
